pos.personaBrief: Possession was stated as a base at his first press conference, and Kroos-Modric-Casemiro circulated the ball, but later sources show direct, transition-based wins and absorb-then-counter play (Coaches' Voice Valencia 2020, therealchamps).

pro.personaBrief: Kroos dropped deep to build, and a safe Casemiro anchor was preferred; the team also accelerated in transition and used long switches to Bale and Carvajal.

est.personaBrief: Flexible midfield with freedom for Modric and Kroos (WFI), Ronaldo moved central, Kroos dropping into half-spaces; a man-management approach rather than a rigid positional model.

lar.personaBrief: Flanks were the primary focus with crossing as the main threat (WFI), and fullbacks provided width; yet the 4-diamond-2 won with no wingers and an extra central midfielder.

blo.personaBrief: Counter-pressing with a unit of five and Casemiro stepping out (Coaches' Voice, WFI) but also absorbing waves and a deeper preserve mode when ahead; not a high-press identity.

mar.personaBrief: Used man-marking in the Dec 2017 Clasico (Casemiro on Messi) and fullbacks man-marking wingers in 2019/20; no set-piece evidence.

pla.personaBrief: Adapted the system (4-3-3, diamond, 3-5-2 trial, 4-4-2 out of possession, man-marking scheme vs Barca, subs to 4-2-3), and shaped the team around the BBC he inherited; pragmatic rather than doctrinaire.

res.personaBrief: Three consecutive Champions Leagues and best defensive record in 2019/20 with games managed to preserve leads (Valencia 2020); results-first, not spectacle-first.

sis.personaBrief: Players of the highest quality given freedom, with Ronaldo and Benzema favored, and his admission he is not the best tactically; the system did not drive results, though his midfield had defined roles.

jog.personaBrief: Technical midfield trio and Isco/Modric preferred, with Casemiro as a physical anchor and Pintus fitness work; both technique and athleticism mattered, technique leaning.

bas.personaBrief: Relied on a consistent core of established stars, rotated sparingly, and refused larger roles for James and Isco; but he developed Asensio, Valverde and Vinicius.

lid.personaBrief: Man-management and harmony were central: 'they have to like you', talking to players, knowing when to shut up, a united dressing room; stars treated with tact and listened to, not iron-fisted.
